title: Credit Risk Model Data Analyst
full_description:
ING Hubs Poland is hiring!
The expected salary for this position:7 100 - 15 000 PLN
The financial ranges specified in the announcement are adjusted and may differ from the range specified in the remuneration regulations.
We are looking for you if:
you're proficient with SQL
you know how to program very well in SAS (4GL) in SAS Enterprise Guide
you have experience collaborating on code through GIT
you can interpret data on your own based on the collected information and assumptions
you have an ability to clearly and succinctly express ideas, facts and opinions and express them fluently both in speaking and writing (also in English language), supported by appropriate tools
you know how to identify problems, analyzing key information and making connections, in order to find appropriate solutions
you can complete tasks and achieves results in an efficient, timely and high-quality manner, with a focus on execution and delivery of targets and KPIs
you have experience in working in the area of financial or credit risk
English level -B2You'll get extra points for:
understanding of the credit process at the Bank
experience in working with credit or market risk modeling (PD, LGD, EAD, IFRS9, IRB)
experience in working with Agile / Scrum
advanced analytical skills
understanding why and how to measure data quality of a given dataset
building ETL data processes
independent, creative and proactive way of thinking
ability to question the status quo
knowledge of techniques used in business analysis
experience with Azure DevOps
documenting work in Confluence
Your responsibilities:
preparing data for risk modeling
developing SAS\SQL process to deliver datasets in a repeatable manner
data quality assessment and root cause analysis
analysis of internal and external regulations and preparation of functional documentation on this basis
ad-hoc data analysis and preparation of reports
Information about the squad:
We are looking for specialists / experts to join the Wholesale Banking Credit Risk Model Data team to contribute to building data management processes resulting in delivering datasets for risk models and management reports in the area of credit risk. We combine knowledge of risk modeling and advanced data processing. We have extensive knowledge of the Bank's processes, which enables us to understand and interpret data for the purposes of modeling and reporting the phenomena accompanying these processes. We work in an international environment, we use English on a daily basis (written and spoken). Our work focuses on data analysis and preparing datasets for modeling and reporting, paying close attention to quality and completeness of the datasets delivered.
The role naming convention in the global ING job architecture will be “Data Scientist II”.
The financial ranges specified in the announcement are adjusted and may differ from the range specified in the remuneration regulations.
